body.text: DOJ threatens to sue Minnesota over its permit-to-purchase law — and wants an answer by Wednesday

On Thursday 17 September the Assistant Attorney General for Civil Rights sent a pre-suit letter to Minnesota's governor and the Minneapolis and St. Paul mayors, saying the state's licensing scheme "imposes unreasonable barriers" to acquiring arms. It attacks processing delay, not the permit requirement — nothing is filed, nothing is enjoined, and the law is in force.
